data.name: Asna
data.gender_notes: Asna is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Asna means 'grace, beauty, purity'. This name is derived from the Arabic root word 'asna', which signifies being pleasing or delightful to the senses. In Islamic history, Asna is the name of a noblewoman and the wife of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) as mentioned in the Hadith. The name Asna carries the meaning “Grace, beauty, purity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Asna usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, beauty, purity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Asna belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, beauty, purity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asna total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
